evidence.detail: The class is stateless apart from reusable static output arrays and a write cursor; both public methods accept center X/Y/Z, radius/size and packed color and return packed X/Y/Z/color particle vertices.
The full-detail method writes 216 ints = 54 vertices = 18 triangles around the supplied center, using the supplied radius symmetrically across all three axes.
The reduced-detail method writes 72 ints = 18 vertices = 6 triangles around the same center/radius contract.

R87 GpuRenderer and R96 ModelPusher both select reduced geometry when their boolean detail selector is true (6 triangles / 18 vertices) and full geometry when false (18 triangles / 54 vertices), then append the returned packed ints directly to GpuIntBuffer.

Both consuming paths operate on R98 GpuParticleInstance values and derive center position, particle size and packed particle color/alpha immediately before invoking this helper, fixing the geometry domain as GPU particle mesh emission.

proposals.note: GpuParticleMeshBuilder is descriptive exact-behavior recovery. Exact v308 proves a stateless full/reduced particle mesh builder used only by the GPU particle rendering paths; no surviving original public source identifier was found.
